body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/8bcdeb8d8fa7dd18edbc4f7fa47c23860b805e61.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3]NEW MAP: Trickster's Delusion[/h3][list][*][p]The Sleepless District will be the new Realm[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/477CDJX3V5JL/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3]NEW SURVIVOR: KWON TAE-YOUNG[/h3][p][b]New Survivor perks:[/b][/p][p][b]Flow State[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a generator is completed, earn [b]1[/b] token, up to [b]5[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]For each token:[/p][list][*][p]You bless and cleanse Totems [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]You heal [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]You unhook Survivors [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]A Place For Us[/b][/p][list][*][p]While healing another Survivor, you both gain [b]Elusive[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you finish healing The Obsession, they gain [b]Elusive [/b]for [b]20/25/30[/b]s.[/p][/*][*][p]When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Five Moves Ahead[/b][/p][list][*][p]While you are in the Killer's Terror radius or chased by the Killer:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Auras of the [b]5[/b] closest Pallets and Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]You drop Pallets [b]50[/b]% faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: [b]30/25/20[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/QDW8CMU7DIWL/bar-red-2.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Gameplay Features[/b][/h2][h3]Killer Updates[/h3][p][b]Killer Update - The Trickster[/b][/p][p][b]Summary[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Trickster now gains Style Points by throwing Blades, injuring Survivors and performing distinct gameplay actions back-to-back.[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster goes up in Style Ranks by earning Style Points.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Style Rank improves The Trickster's Blade throw and Locker Restocking speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Main Event can now only be activated once reaching the highest Style Rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Points and Style Ranks are tracked via a new user interface element custom-made for The Trickster.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Basekit[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Trickster's movement speed decreased to [b]4.4m/s[/b] [i](was 4.6 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Blade count decreased to [b]36 [/b][i](was 44)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Terror Radius to [b]24m [/b][i](was 32m)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased time to enter Throw State to [b]0.3s [/b][i](was 0.35s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased time to exit Throw State to [b]1.15s[/b] [i](was 1.25s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased time between Blade throws to [b]0.33s[/b] [i](was 0.3s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased base Throw State movement speed to [b]3.68m/s [/b][i](was 3.86m/s)[/i].[/p][list][*][p]After [b]8 [/b]consecutive Blade throws, Throw State movement speed is decreased to[b] 3.53 m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After [b]16[/b] consecutive Blade throws, Throw State movement speed is decreased to [b]3.16 m/s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increase Blade throw rate per Blade thrown:[/p][list][*][p]After [b]8[/b] consecutive Blade throws, the throw rate increased by [b]50%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]After [b]16[/b] consecutive Blade throws, the throw rate is increased by [b]100%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Laceration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Laceration now only counted using whole numbers [i](previously decayed into decimals)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration Meter decreased to [b]6[/b] [i](was 8)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration Meter decay delay decreased to [b]12s[/b] [i](was 15s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Laceration stack decay time to [b]3s[/b] [i](was 2s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration visual feedback updated.[/p][list][*][p]Now displayed on the Survivor directly, for both Survivors and Killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration cuts removed from Survivors' user interface.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Style Points[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Trickster performing combo actions generates Style Points.[/p][list][*][p]A combo action is triggered when two back-to-back gameplay actions are distinct.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following actions generate [b]1 Style Point[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with a Blade [i](first-hit only).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Injuring a Survivor [i](from Laceration or basic-attack).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hooking a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Basic-breaking a Downed Pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]Basic-breaking a Breakable Wall.[/p][/*][*][p]Damaging a Generator.[/p][/*][*][p]Snuffing a Boon Totem.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following actions generate [b]2 Style Points[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with [b]4[/b] Blades from at least [b]4m [/b][i](without missing or exiting the Throw State).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with a Blade from more than [b]16m [/b]away.[/p][/*][*][p]Interrupting a Survivor.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The following actions generate [b]3 Style Points[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with a Blade through small gaps.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Style Ranks[/b][/p][list][*][p]There are 6 Style Ranks: E, D, C, B, A and S-Rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Ranks each have their respective bonus maximum throw rate and Locker restocking speed modifiers.[/p][list][*][p]Higher bonuses at higher ranks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Higher Style Ranks require more Style Points to reach.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher Style Ranks feature progressively shorter combo timers.[/p][list][*][p]Ranks regress to previous in order if combo timer ever lapses.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Earning Style Points refreshes the current Style Rank's combo timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Rank combo timers are paused while The Trickster is performing interactions with Survivors or interactable objects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]S-Rank[/b][/p][list][*][p]When reaching of S-Rank[/p][list][*][p]Survivors within [b]44m[/b] of The Trickster are revealed via Killer Instinct for [b]4.4s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]All Survivors are notified across the Trial.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While in S-Rank:[/p][list][*][p]The Trickster gains a [b]44m [/b]Terror radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Lullaby is disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Laceration Meters decay [b]50%[/b] slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Blade throw and Locker restock speeds increased to maximum.[/p][/*][*][p]Main Event can be activated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]S-Rank has a [b]66s [/b]combo timer.[/p][list][*][p]S-Rank [b]cannot[/b] be paused or refreshed [i](unlike lower Style Ranks)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]S-Rank [b]always [/b]reverts to E-Rank [i](via timer, or once Main Event ends)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Main Event[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press the Secondary Ability button to activate Main Event[/p][list][*][p]Main Event lasts [b]8s[/b] [i](was 6s).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster throws Blades at at [b]1.67x[/b] the default Blade throw speed.[/p][list][*][p][i]Note: not affected by Consecutive Blade Throw and Style Rank Blade Throw modifiers.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Survivors near The Trickster are notified.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While performing Main Event:[/p][list][*][p]S-Rank timer is paused.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Blade hitting Survivors awards bonus Style Points.[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster can cancel Main Even via the Secondary Ability button.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When Main Event ends:[/p][list][*][p]The Trickster's Power goes on cooldown for [b]4s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]S-Rank resets to E-Rank[/p][/*][*][p]The Trickster goes up in Style Ranks over time, based on bonus Style Points earned during Main Event.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Trickster's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Memento Blades [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Displays[/b] a reticle while aiming with Blades.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Trick Pouch [/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] maximum carried [b]Blades[/b] by [b]4[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Start the Trial with [b]4[/b] extra [b]Blades[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Killing Part Chords [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] time before Style Ranks from D to A decay by [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Inferno Wires [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Decreases[/b] Showstopper's cooldown after Main Event by [b]10%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ji-Woon's Autograph [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] the duration of Main Event by [b]33%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lucky Blade [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]On every eighth Blade Hit, an additional bonus is assigned at random:[/p][list][*][p][b]Increases [/b]Laceration by [b]100%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gain 3%[/b] Haste for [b]3 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gain[/b] an additional Style Point.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Caged Heart Shoes [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] movement speed while in the Throw State by [b]1%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tequila Moonrock [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] Throw Speed by [b]10%[/b] for [b]8 seconds[/b] after gaining a Style Rank.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bloody Boa [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Decreases[/b] the speed at which Laceration decays by [b]10%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]On Target Single [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] time before Laceration starts decaying by [b]15%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fizz-Spin Soda [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] the number of Blade Throws required to slow movement speed while throwing by [b]2[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Waiting for You Watch [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Survivors whose Laceration Meter fully decays are revealed for [b]4 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ripper Brace [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]For each Style Rank, you basic-vault Windows, basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, and damage Generators [b]3% [/b]faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Melodious Murder[/p][list][*][p][b]Increases Blade[/b] reload speed at lockers by [b]25%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Diamond Cufflinks[/p][list][*][p]Reveals Survivors' auras for [b]6 seconds[/b] when their Laceration reaches one [b]Blade[/b] hit from maximum.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Edge of Revival Album [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Blade Hits from more than [b]32 meters[/b] away deal [b]100%[/b] more Laceration.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cut Thru U Single [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]When reaching a new Style Rank, adds a stackable [b]1% Haste[/b] bonus. All stacks last until Style Rank decreases by any means.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Death Throes Compilation [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Refills[/b] Blades by [b]50%[/b] of the maximum when Main Event ends.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Iridescent Photocard [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Increases[/b] the duration of Main Event by [b]100%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When Main Event is activated, reveals your aura to all Survivors and blocks all generators for [b]6 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]** src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/G5PZENP5BFZM/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3]Killer Actions Update[/h3][list][*][p]Accompanying the new language found in the Perks Description Update (see UX section below), we have expanded our distinction between basic and special actions performed by Killers.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting in update 9.5.0, the following terms will now appear in Power, Add-on and Perk descriptions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Basic-break[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Pallet or Breakable Wall is broken by the default ability of any Killer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Special-break[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Downed Pallet or Breakable Wall is broken due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Basic-vault[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Window is vaulted by the default ability of any Killer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Special-vault[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Window or Downed Pallet is vaulted due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Damaging Generators[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Generator is damaged and loses progress due to the default ability of any Killer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Generator Explosions[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a Generator loses progress due to an ability granted by a Killer's Power or Perk.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]With these new terms, we intend to express with increased accuracy when specific gameplay interactions are intended to work alongside one another.[/p][list][*][p]Notably Killer Powers and Killer Perks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Multiple gameplay descriptions. been updated to surface these new interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]The
